result:
I fixed all three problems. Type-checking passes and `tests/server/jobs.test.ts` passes, but I didn't run the full test suite.

1. **Switching off didn't stick:** in `src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts`, `updateEndpoint` only saved the `enabled` flag when it was `true`, so switching an endpoint off was silently dropped. It now saves `false` as well. New events already skip switched-off endpoints, so no new deliveries get queued once the setting actually saves.
2. **Old queued events still went out:** in `src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts`, the delivery run now marks a queued delivery as failed ("endpoint is switched off") and adds it to the failed count. It already did this for endpoints that no longer exist, and deliveries for endpoints that are on are handled as before.
3. **Switched-off endpoints didn't count toward the plan limit:** in `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`, `createWebhook` now counts every endpoint, on or off, so switching one off no longer frees up room for another.
